title: Ihi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He had two sons, great and pious men in Israel: Avuha and Meniman, as in Megillah 28a. They lived in Shmuel's time, as explained in their entries. Eruvin 74a reads Ivot bar Ihi, but Hyman says it should read Avuha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source’s irregular גדול ישראל וחסידים describes the two sons in context; the English does not split it into one great son and another pious son. The proposed Ivot/Avuha correction remains Hyman’s.
The consulted Megillah 28a names Avuha and Minyamin bar Ihi. Eruvin 74a has Ayvut bar Ihi in an episode involving Shmuel. Hyman proposes Avuha for the latter name.
